title: 2551. Put Marbles in Bags

examples.explanation: The distribution [1],[3,5,1] results in the minimal score of (1+1) + (3+1) = 6. The distribution [1,3],[5,1], results in the maximal score of (1+3) + (5+1) = 10. Thus, we return their difference 10 - 6 = 4.
The only distribution possible is [1],[3]. Since both the maximal and minimal score are the same, we return 0.
